summary: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints teaches that its official scriptures, the standard works, are the Bible, the Book of Mormon, the Doctrine and Covenants and the Pearl of Great Price. The words of prophets and apostles, when they write or speak by the power of the Holy Ghost, "shall be scripture", the page says, quoting modern revelation. The Articles of Faith say the Bible is the word of God as far as it is translated correctly, that the Book of Mormon is also the word of God, and that God has revealed and will yet reveal great and important things.
